# ReelRole

> ReelRole is a video-first hiring platform. Talent (including remote high-ticket sales closers) records a 30–90 second video instead of sending a CV. Companies browse video profiles for free and pay only to unlock contact details: €5 per unlock or €20/month for unlimited unlocks. Free for talent, always. Operated by Equinox Investment Group LLC.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://reelrole.com/): what ReelRole is
- [For Talent](https://reelrole.com/for-talent): how candidates create a video profile
- [For Closers](https://reelrole.com/closers): remote high-ticket closer jobs and hiring closers by video
- [For Companies](https://reelrole.com/for-companies): how companies find and unlock candidates
- [Pricing](https://reelrole.com/pricing): Talent free · €5 per unlock · €20/month Premium
- [Trending Talent](https://reelrole.com/trending): public video profiles
- [Record a video](https://reelrole.com/guest-video-recording): start without an account
- [Help](https://reelrole.com/help) · [Contact](https://reelrole.com/contact): hello@reelrole.com

## Policies
- [Privacy](https://reelrole.com/privacy) · [Terms](https://reelrole.com/terms) · [GDPR](https://reelrole.com/gdpr) · [Cookies](https://reelrole.com/cookies)

## Closers (high-ticket sales)
- ReelRole is focused on remote high-ticket closers: each closer records a 30-90 second video and can add average ticket, niches (real estate, coaching, online courses, investments, SaaS, travel), years closing and expected commission.
- Companies filter closers by niche, ticket, language, country and availability, watch for free and pay only to contact.
- Closers never pay: https://reelrole.com/closers
- Shortlist service: email hello@reelrole.com to receive 3 matching closers within 48 hours.
